title: Done plan items lose the dim colour after their first character
observed: Muted(Strike(s)): lipgloss strikes one cell at a time with a reset after each, cancelling the outer dim colour, so the rest of the text drew in the terminal default (sampled ~rgb 202,204,202 vs dim 152,141,117).
expected: Done items dim with a line through, every character (Terminal.dc.html plan: c:C.dim, line-through).
